## What are you critiquing?

Link or quote the exact chapter, thesis, policy, or design principle.

## The problem

What contradiction, hidden assumption, missing tradeoff, exclusion, or unintended consequence do you see?

## Who is affected?

Be specific about population, place, institution, disability, income, culture, age, or other context when relevant.

## Is this an evidence problem or a value disagreement?

Evidence / Value / Political mechanism / Multiple

## Counterexample

Where does the Human Scale framing predict the wrong thing or create the opposite of its intended result?

## Better formulation

How would you rewrite or redesign the idea?

## What should remain?

Name any part of the original idea worth preserving.

## What would change your mind?

What evidence or argument would make you revise this critique?
